invariants: Leaf outcomes are exactly: proven / refuted / split

A bet card is immutable after registration; void and re-open, never edit
A card's author never scores it
The board is append-only; state is exported back as snapshots
The lead is never the only release authority
The external auditor is a genuinely external seat, not a role an insider simulates
